provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: The hm values are hardcoded run results (source runs not referenced); gradient() uses unit spacing rather than the non-uniform dx, so hmg is the raw successive-difference estimate, not d(hm)/d(dx) -- acceptable for the qualitative 'difference in setup' label but not a true derivative.
audit_member_text: Cross-line quantity mismatch across L1,L3,L5,L9: dx is nonuniform (successive doubling), but gradient is called without dx and therefore differentiates with respect to unit sample index; the resulting endpoint/central differences are then plotted against dx and labeled as a setup difference, not as an index-gradient or a derivative with respect to grid spacing.
No reference value or selected convergence-order fit is defined, so the plotted hmg cannot by itself distinguish consecutive-resolution differences from error relative to a converged solution.
